transcript: Weird day, emotionally all over the place. Woke up anxious about a review that turned out totally fine, actually kind of great. Then got some annoying news about a rent increase around lunch that put me in a bad mood for hours. But then a random old friend texted out of nowhere in the evening and that completely turned things around, felt really happy by the end of the night.
